name: ML Hail and Tornado Climatology
description: An interactive AI application on Hugging Face Spaces.

paragraphs: The hazard selector switches between hail and tornado climatologies for 2005–2011. Tornado data lives in data/tornado//.json, with its own index. Regenerate it using python buildtornadodata.py PATHTOMODELOUTPUT. Only preddetector == 1 clusters are exported. Tornado s1 is the calibrated pdetectorcal (detection threshold 0.267); s2 preserves predintensity: 0 = Severe (EF0–1), 1 = Significant-Severe (EF2+). The two-stage CatBoost model estimates intensity only for detected clusters. Counts represent cluster snapshots, not unique tornado events. Source CSV files are left unchanged.
